description: This file defines the 'toMatchText' matcher function used in testing, which compares text content of Playwright page or locator objects against expected string or RegExp patterns, including detailed formatting and error handling.

methods.name: toMatchText
methods.description: Asynchronous function that checks if the text content of a Playwright Locator or Page matches an expected string or RegExp, with support for options like timeout and substring matching, returning a detailed result object.
